# Migration from v0.x to v1.x

This section if for you if you are using the legacy **`@horizon/components-react`** (v0.x) version and want to migrate to the **`@airbus/components-react`** (v1.x) version.

While it's possible to migrate incrementally in a development branch, **we recommend not to mix both versions in production**.

If you're asking yourself if and how you should plan the migration, you will find some information on this page about what's missing, renamed or deprecated.

## Component status

Components that have been **renamed or deprecated**

| v0 name             | v1 name (or alternative)                    | Status                                                   |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Appbar              | Header                                      | See <a href="#header">Header migration</a>               |
| Breadcrumbs         | Breadcrumb                                  | -                                                        |
| ChoiceField         | FormControl + Select/RadioGroup/ComboBox    | See <a href="#form-control">Form Control migration</a>   |
| CSSBaseline         | -                                           | See <a href="#themeprovider">ThemeProvider migration</a> |
| DataGrid            | DataTable                                   | See <a href="#data-table">Data Table migration</a>       |
| DateField           | FormControl + DatePicker                    | See <a href="#form-control">Form Control migration</a>   |
| Field               | FormControl                                 | See <a href="#form-control">Form Control migration</a>   |
| Incremental         | NumericInput                                | -                                                        |
| Label               | Typography                                  | -                                                        |
| LinearProgress      | ProgressBar                                 | -                                                        |
| Logo                | -                                           | See <a href="#header">Header migration</a>               |
| Notification        | Toast                                       | -                                                        |
| MultipleChoiceField | FormControl + CheckboxGroup/Select/ComboBox | See <a href="#form-control">Form Control migration</a>   |
| Panel               | Collapsible                                 | -                                                        |
| Paper               | -                                           | Deprecated                                               |
| SegmentedControl    | ButtonGroup                                 | See <a href="#button-group">Button Group migration</a>   |
| Slider              | RangeSlider                                 | -                                                        |
| TextField           | FormControl + Textarea/Input                | See <a href="#form-control">Form Control migration</a>   |
| Title               | Typography                                  | -                                                        |
| Toolbar             | -                                           | See <a href="#header">Header migration</a>               |
| Typeahead           | ComboBox                                    | -                                                        |
| Wrap                | Inline                                      | -                                                        |

## Deprecation warnings

For the components that exist in both versions, we generally tried to keep the same component names and props in the v1.

For the few cases where we decided to deprecate component names or props, we added **console warnings** (only visible in development mode) to help you migrate.
Deprecated props are also documented in the props table of each component.

<div className="sbdocs-warning">
  <Source
    code={`[AIRBUS-DS] Button 'primary' prop is deprecated. Use 'variant' instead.
[AIRBUS-DS] AppBar is deprecated. Please use Header.`}
    language="none"
  />
</div>

## Components

### ThemeProvider

The `ThemeProvider` top-level component is no more mandatory in v1. The components will use the Airbus theme by default without doing anything special.<br />
Same for the `CSSBaseline` component that does not exist anymore. Baseline styles are automatically injected.
See <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Introduction" story="docs">Styling</LinkTo>.

### Header

<div className="sbdocs-compare">
  <Source code={`// v0.x
<AppBar static>
  <Toolbar disableGutters>
    <Logo />
    <AppTitle style={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>App name</AppTitle>
    <Tabs dark>
      <Tab label="Panel 1" />
      <Tab label="Panel 2" />
      <Tab label="Panel 3" />
    </Tabs>
  </Toolbar>
</AppBar>`} language="jsx" />
  <Source code={`// v1.x
<Header appName="App Name">
  <Tabs>
    <Tab>Panel 1</Tab>
    <Tab>Panel 2</Tab>
    <Tab>Panel 3</Tab>
  </Tabs>
</Header>`} language="jsx" />
</div>

- `AppBar` renamed to `Header`
- No need to add `Logo` and `AppTitle` children
- No need to manually set dark mode on `Tabs`

### Form Control

In v0, you had two options to build forms

- Using generic wrappers (eg. `BooleanField`, `ChoiceField`, etc.)
- Using concrete controls (eg. `Radio`, `Checkbox`, etc.)

It added a lot of complexity, and it was not clear which approach to choose.

In v1, we removed generic wrappers, and provided instead a unique `FormControl` component to manage form control label, error, etc.
See <LinkTo kind="General/Forms/Introduction" story="docs">Forms introduction</LinkTo>.

<div className="sbdocs-compare">
  <Source code={`// v0.x
<BooleanField control="checkbox" label="Label" />
<BooleanField control="toggle" label="Label" />
<ChoiceField control="select" label="Label" />
<ChoiceField control="radiogroup" label="Label" />
<ChoiceField control="typeahead" label="Label" />
<DateField label="Label" />
<MultipleChoiceField control="checkboxgroup" label="Label" />
<MultipleChoiceField control="typeahead" label="Label" />
<TextField label="Label" />
<TextField multiline label="Label" />`} language="jsx" />
  <Source code={`// v1.x
<FormControl label="Label"><CheckBox /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><Toggle /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><Select /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><RadioGroup /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><ComboBox /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><DatePicker /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><CheckboxGroup /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><ComboBox multiple /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><Input /></FormControl>
<FormControl label="Label"><Textarea /></FormControl>`} language="jsx" />
</div>

### Data Table

We migrated from `fixed-data-table-2` to `react-table` internally.<br />
The main impact of this is that column configuration format has changed.
see <LinkTo kind="Components/DataTable" story="basic">Data Table</LinkTo>.

<div className="sbdocs-compare">
  <Source code={`// v0.x
const columns = [
  {
    dataKey: "name",
    label: "Full Name",
    width: 300,
    resizable: false,
    sortable: false,
    cellRenderer: TooltipCell,
  }
]`} language="jsx" />
  <Source code={`// v1.x
const columns = [
  {
    id: "name",
    Header: "Full Name",
    width: 300,
    disableResizing: true,
    disableSortBy: true,
    Cell: TooltipCell,
  }
]`} language="jsx" />
</div>

### Button Group

<div className="sbdocs-compare">
  <Source code={`// v0.x
<SegmentedControl selected={1}>
  <div>One</div>
  <div>Two</div>
  <div>Three</div>
</SegmentedControl>`} language="jsx" />
  <Source code={`// v1.x
<ButtonGroup>
  <Button>One</Button>
  <Button pressed>Two</Button>
  <Button>Three</Button>
</ButtonGroup>`} language="jsx" />
</div>
